local_findings.fact: git.deploymentEnabled contains five false feature-branch entries, including the Epic15 feature branch, but no main entry or global disable. No local ignoreCommand is present.
local_findings.consequence: The owned feature-branch disable does not follow a merge to main. The local source alone cannot establish that a main merge will avoid a production deployment.

local_findings.fact: The retained project read qualified only point-in-time ordinary owned-feature-branch Git-push build skipping. previewDeploymentsDisabled=true; shared commandForIgnoringBuildStep='exit 0'; gitProviderOptions.createDeployments='enabled'. Qualification freshness was 300 seconds.
local_findings.consequence: Neither preview disable, the dated feature-branch qualification nor the mere shared exit0 string independently proves production/main auto-deployment containment. Cancelled deployment records may exist. Manual/CLI/deployment-hook routes were not qualified and are not authorized here.

local_findings.fact: ci.yml push main runs verification, production build, isolated local integration/RLS/browser and isolated recovery lanes. It has no Vercel deployment or hosted Supabase db push step. auto-bmad-parallel and cloudflare-monitor-verify are main-push path-filtered verification workflows; the latter runs wrangler deploy --dry-run only. The fixed-Chromium mock proof is feature-branch-push scoped.
local_findings.consequence: Merging can start CI workloads even without application deployment. Existing user conditional merge intent must be satisfied before merge; checks after a merge do not retroactively qualify the pre-merge head.

local_findings.fact: pilot availability and backup are scheduled/manual main workflows; isolated recovery rehearsal is manual main only. PR-feedback remediation is schedule/comment/manual main automation, not a main-push deployment step. Current hosted enabling variables/secrets are not read or asserted here.
local_findings.consequence: These local declarations are not proof that hosted operations are presently enabled or disabled. No change, dispatch, suspension or global settings update is proposed.

local_findings.fact: Dated demo instructions describe Vercel auto-deploy from main and a separate supabase db push after merge. Historical READY deployments demonstrate that main previously had such a route, not its current configuration.
local_findings.consequence: The current NO-deployment condition supersedes any implied follow-on deployment or hosted migration action in the older runbook. No supabase db push, hosted schema apply, manual Vercel deployment or production promotion is included in a merge.

local_findings.fact: The config declares an /api/jobs/run cron every five minutes.
local_findings.consequence: A production deployment would not be merely a passive source publication. This assessment does not exercise the endpoint, alter an existing deployment or claim that already-running production jobs stop when merging is held.

minimum_remaining_plan.status: Read-only proof plan; no effects or new authority.
before_merge: Freeze the reviewed final Epic15 source and actual final PR head; obtain final independently qualified required development/functional evidence for that head, including full95 and separate recovery/custody where required. Preserve nonexecution, deferred-release and unknown limits. Obtain Coordinator's fresh-chat external review and resolve consequential findings. Retain merge-commit and branch-preservation requirements.

Immediately before an eventual merge, use one separately admitted read-only project-settings request through the existing owned project/team qualification lane. Bind exact provider project/team/repository, actual production branch, Git deployment creation/production auto-deployment control, preview setting and ignored-build behavior. Inspect the exact final main-merge candidate vercel.json and any relevant project build-ignore override together; an owned-feature-branch map is insufficient.

Qualify an enforced control that actually covers production/main Git merges. If the existing shared ignored-build gate is the proposed control, establish its current production applicability and the exact candidate's inability to override it; do not infer that from its string or preview setting. If the returned settings cannot prove that invariant, keep the merge blocked. The smallest further step is a separately authorized supported main/production Git auto-deployment containment change plus fresh exact readback, not a trial merge/deploy. No provider-setting change is authorized by this assessment.

Refresh exact PR-head/target-main identity and required check/review status as part of the actual finite merge operation. Reuse unchanged local workflow/config hashes; inspect only actual intervening automation/config deltas. Reconcile conditional human merge authorization and any merge_main:false operational override explicitly; this report changes neither.

Allocate only the actual merge and bounded evidence/readback operation once all prerequisites are true. No deployment, promotion, db push, optional diagnostic, cleanup or settings restoration is implied. Keep the existing deployment prohibition in the final handoff.
minimum_remaining_plan.why_minimal: Reuse the already-reviewed provider transport and closed public projections with production/main-specific data and proof; no collector/controller framework or new runtime experiment. Local source establishes no hosted deploy command in these workflows, so no CI redesign is indicated.
minimum_remaining_plan.read_only_uncertainty: One project read may expose a sufficient existing main/production control; if it does not, read-only evidence cannot manufacture containment. Hold for the concrete authorized configuration correction instead of expanding diagnostics or assuming safety.
